reviews.x: Newest update... 2nd light they sent me quit working again.. I dont recomend Update... company has contacted me and they will send out a new one. Cross my fingers this one will last a but longer. But at least they are prompt at resolving this issue  After purchasing the product and having it only a month. The adapter/plug quit working. The light on the plug doesn't turn on to indicate that its functioning

I received this last night and have used it this morning. So light weight. So comfortable (no burning). So sleek and stylish, but simple to use. Good bye nail salon. I do my own acrylic nails and use only regular polish. So happy I waited and bought this one. You'll not be disappointed. Ordered Sunday, received Tuesday!!

Best nail lamp ever! I’m a nail technician, so a nail lamp is required for my job. I’ve been using this nail lamp for 2 weeks and I felt happy that I bought it. The lamp helps dry nail gel I put on customers’ fingernail very quickly. The nail lamp is inexpensive but it doesn’t feel cheap at all. I recommended this nail lamp for two of my coworkers, they liked it so much that they already placed order for 2 more lamps. Overall, this lamp is your best bang for the buck.

This UV lamp has it all, it’s petite, cute and easy to carry from nail stations to pedicures. It has 4 settings for the amount of light desired and it has an automatic sensor up to 120 secs. I discovered that sometimes when I do a gel pedicure, the light does not cure the pinky toe; therefore I have to spend an extra 30 secs and shift the lamp towards that angle. I’ve tried checking if the light was out and it was not so it can’t be that. Which I don’t mind but, I’m used to having all toenails c

Greattt item!! Its very easy to use and its very light so its easy to carry around. It dry my gel color evenly and my gel stay on for many weeks without any chip. It came with 4 timer set, 10s, 30s, 60s and 99s but it can do automaticly on and off whenever you put and take out your hand under the light. Not to mention: the machines color is pretty!! Good qualityyy  PS: my wife do the review and test it.
Very disappointed in this item, the ac/dc adapter had a short in the cord upon arrival. Lesson learned to save the shipping labels to send back. Very very disappointed.
I had never used one of these before and I was disappointed.  I thought it would dry my nails much faster.
The light isn’t try good... badly choose

I was originally very displeased with this lamp because it came with a European plug, which I have no way of using. The company very quickly and generously emailed me to resolve the issue and are sending me a whole lamp as a replacement for the inconvenience. I really appreciate good customer service and with the proper adapter I was able to get the European style plug to work and the lamp works fantastic! Thank you!

reviews.t: Works for toes and all 5 fingers. Love the large size
reviews.x: I spent a few extra dollars and bought this one in particular it seems to be the best wattage and UV for the price point.  I also like that I can get all five fingers in and also I love the fact that when I’m doing toes all I need to do is slip my foot in and put it on the floor and it works perfectly for that as well.. highly recommend!

This was my first UV/LED light to do gel nails at home. I had nothing to compare it to.  But it's not great. It pretty much sux. When the polish states cure 45 secs. I do about 4 rounds of 99 secs just to get it (almost) dry with this lamp. I thought I did good selecting one that had more wattage,  but I guess not.

reviews.t: So happy I made the switch to this LED lamp!
reviews.x: I previously had a UV lamp bit was wanting to make the switch to LED. SO glad that i made the switch tonthis LED lamp. My favorite feature is that it turns on automatically when you insert your hand. It also has a clear timer counter lettimg you know how long you have been curing for.

This nail lamp worked great it dried the nails fast and I loved the automatic sensor...but I used it for only a month and it stopped working! I contacted the company and they responded promptly and are sending another one! Hopefully I’ll have better luck with this one!

My mom got this for me for my bday to use for a polygel kit and also gel nails. I works to cure both amazingly! No need for an expensive one or higher powered. This one for the price is perfect! Is had the timer on top and it's super lightweight!

I got this one to see if it cured my polygel faster and it did!!!! Took the dry time to 2 minutes. Fot the price ,you cant beat it. I wish I would of got this one first, but it's a learning process. I'm still an amateur with nails.

Good by nail salon. I am so happy I decided to purchase this item. I tried it out on my toes. I love to do my own pedicure however I sometimes smudge my polish. I used this and in less than a few minutes I’m polished and done. 🙌🏾

My first uv nail light. always saw it in the nail salon. never thought one day i could own one of my own. it's so cute! the pink. omg looks like a shell almost. it has a timer on it!!!! that's so cool! love it so much.

Have used it a couple time with my clients and I simply love it. Dries gel fast. Has different timers selection and is easy to use. You can remove the bottom piece as well to use it for pedis. Better than expected !
I’ve never thought this up lamp would work lite it does, I search for a whole week and I finally decided to get this one and let me told you it works great for nail/gel curing!
This lamp works perfectly and drys my gel nails so fast. Its so much better than my last lamp! This product works very well and super easy to use. So glad I bought this!
Was a decent uv lamp. I had trouble curing thicker colors such as Perfect Match. It would wrinkle overtime or immediately. As a nail tech it is not a reliable uv lamp.
I got this to do gel nails at home. It works extremely well. Doing my own nails at home has saved me tons of money.
Takes awhile for my nails to fully dry. I would have to dry my nails 4 times to get my nails to be decent dry.
Product stopped working after 3 short uses . No drops or spills, the light just cut out randomly .
Love it. The only issue is the cord is really short making it hard to use for professional uses.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lamp lightweight, easy to use, and good value for the price.
Several reviewers praise the automatic sensor and timer settings.
Some reviewers report the lamp stopped working or had a faulty plug/adapter, though the company responded promptly with replacements.
A few reviewers say it does not cure or dry nails quickly enough.
Some reviewers note it cures gel and polygel well and quickly.
